_comment: Function name map: hex_address -> name. Traced via mipsel-linux-gnu-objdump --architecture=mips:5900
_comment_ghidra_audit: Added/renamed after the Ghidra audit: SDK library identifications and the real main loop
_comment_scenes: Scene constructors and vtable methods (see include/engine/scene.h for ids)
_comment_game_scene: GameScene (title/front end) and its mode objects
_comment_title_menu: Title menu, sprite sets, keyframe tracks
_comment_assets: Archive, asset queue, sprite sheets, title background
_boot_sequence: 0x100008 __start: zero BSS, SetupThread/SetupHeap syscalls, _InitSys, then main
0x1001e0 main: libc init, static ctors, App_Init(0x2EE960), App_Run(0x2EE960)
0x1e0e60 App_Init: engine setup, logo movies (SPIKE/ACQUIRE .PSS), creates first scene via Scene_Create(0)
0x1e09f0 App_Run: the main loop - calls scene vtable (+0x2C) Start/Update/Draw each frame
0x119610 Exit: called with main's return value
